# MegaChad

> Burn-to-create looksmaxxing engine and MegaETH universal portal. Burn $MEGACHAD tokens to generate AI-enhanced portraits, mint NFTs, and earn on-chain reputation. Features cross-chain intents, natural language transactions, identity layer, and 20 MCP tools. ERC-8004 registered agent with x402 payment support.

MegaChad is a burn-to-create protocol and MegaETH portal (chain ID 4326). Users burn 225,000 $MEGACHAD tokens (split: 112,500 to dead address + 112,500 to tren fund) along with a 1 USDm infra fee via x402 to generate AI looksmaxxed portraits and mint them as NFTs.

The protocol has two tokens: $MEGACHAD (primary burn token) and $MEGAGOONER (governance/reward token minted via burn participation).

- Chain: MegaETH (chain ID 4326, ~250ms blocks)
- RPC: https://mainnet.megaeth.com/rpc
- ERC-8004 Agent ID: 12408
- x402 Payments: via Meridian (1 USDm per looksmaxx)

## API Documentation

- [Protocol Registry](https://megachad.xyz/.well-known/megachad-protocol.json): Canonical machine-readable registry of every deployed contract (tokens, AMM, staking, governance, emissions, safety). PULL THIS FIRST for any DeFi interaction.
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://megachad.xyz/.well-known/openapi.json): Full API schema for all endpoints
- [Agent Registration](https://megachad.xyz/.well-known/agent-registration.json): ERC-8004 agent identity and services
- [Agent Card (A2A)](https://megachad.xyz/.well-known/agent.json): Google A2A protocol agent card
- [MCP Server](https://megachad.xyz/api/mcp): Model Context Protocol server for tool-based agent interaction

## Core Endpoints

- [Swap Quote](https://megachad.xyz/api/x402/quote): Get swap instructions for buying $MEGACHAD with ETH via Kumbaya DEX
- [Looksmaxx (x402)](https://megachad.xyz/api/x402/looksmaxx): Payment-gated burn-to-create — GET for requirements, POST with burn proof + payment
- [Token Stats](https://megachad.xyz/api/stats): Total supply, circulating supply, tokens burned, burn count
- [Price](https://megachad.xyz/api/price): Current $MEGACHAD price and burn cost in ETH
- [Chadboard](https://megachad.xyz/api/chadboard): Burner leaderboard with tier badges, identity, and ERC-8004 reputation scores
- [Agent Info](https://megachad.xyz/api/agent/info): On-chain identity, registration status, contract addresses
- [Bridge Info](https://megachad.xyz/api/bridge): Bridge infrastructure for moving assets to MegaETH

## Natural Language & Agent Endpoints

- [NLP Chat](https://megachad.xyz/api/agent/chat): POST plain English → structured responses with calldata. Supports 17 intents including swap, burn, looksmaxx, cross-chain, compare, schedule, and multi-burn.
- [Agent Registration](https://megachad.xyz/api/agent/register): Register as referral agent (earn 5% per referred burn)
- [Referral Stats](https://megachad.xyz/api/agent/referrals): Agent earnings and referral count
- [Looksmaxx Plan](https://megachad.xyz/api/agent/looksmaxx): Full step-by-step burn plan with calldata

## Cross-Chain Intents

- [Cross-Chain Intent](https://megachad.xyz/api/cross-chain/intent): Build looksmaxx plans from any of 10 chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB, Avalanche, Scroll, zkSync, Linea). Returns bridge → swap → burn → generate → mint steps.
- [Intent Status](https://megachad.xyz/api/cross-chain/status): Track cross-chain intent progress

## Identity Layer

- [Identity Lookup](https://megachad.xyz/api/identity/ADDRESS): Unified MegaETH identity profile — MegaNames, balances, burn history, reputation, tier, referral stats. Accepts 0x addresses or .mega names.
- [Portfolio](https://megachad.xyz/api/portal/tokens): All MegaETH token balances for a wallet
- [Protocol Directory](https://megachad.xyz/api/portal/protocols): Curated MegaETH protocol directory

## Gasless Burns

- [Gasless Burn](https://megachad.xyz/api/gasless/burn): EIP-712 gasless burn via relayer — no gas fees needed

## Social & Messaging

- [ChadChat Auth](https://megachad.xyz/api/chat/auth): Ably auth token for burn-gated real-time messaging
- [Chat Messages](https://megachad.xyz/api/chat/messages): Message storage for ChadChat
- [Chat Names](https://megachad.xyz/api/chat/name): Display name management
- [Telegram Alerts](https://megachad.xyz/api/telegram/alerts): Burn/mint notification alerts
- [Farcaster Frame](https://megachad.xyz/api/frame): Frame-based gallery and leaderboard navigation

## Infrastructure

- [SSE Events](https://megachad.xyz/api/events): Server-Sent Events stream for real-time burn notifications
- [Analytics](https://megachad.xyz/api/analytics): Per-endpoint and per-MCP-tool usage tracking
- [Early Access](https://megachad.xyz/api/early/register): Beta access registration
- [Warren Deploy](https://megachad.xyz/api/warren/deploy): On-chain permanent image storage
- [NFT Metadata](https://megachad.xyz/api/metadata/TOKEN_ID): ERC-721 metadata for looksmaxxed NFTs

## DeFi Endpoints (MEGA Protocol)

These endpoints back the DeFi MCP tools and `/api/agent/chat` intents. They return JSON with on-chain reads and (for tx builders) ready-to-sign action arrays — `{ to, value, data }` you can feed straight to `eth_sendTransaction`.

- [GET /api/defi/staking](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/staking): Combined MoggerStaking + JESTERGOONER position + global APRs. Pass `?address=0x...` for per-wallet view.
- [GET /api/defi/staking/tx](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/staking/tx): Build stake/unstake/claim. `?action=stake|unstake|claim&venue=mogger|jester&amount=&address=`
- [GET /api/defi/amm/quote](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/amm/quote): MC/MG pool reserves + (with `?from=MC|MG&amount=`) constant-product quote with price impact.
- [GET /api/defi/amm/swap-tx](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/amm/swap-tx): Two-step swap plan (transfer + swap) with off-chain slippage minOut. `?from=MC|MG&amount=&recipient=&slippageBps=`
- [GET /api/defi/amm/add-liquidity-tx](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/amm/add-liquidity-tx): approve+approve+addLiquidity. `?amountMC=&amountMG=&recipient=&address=`
- [GET /api/defi/governance/proposals](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/governance/proposals): List Jestermogger proposals with state + vote tally. `?limit=20`
- [GET /api/defi/governance/proposals/{id}](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/governance/proposals/1): Full proposal: actions, votes, NFT veto state, voter receipt (with `?voter=0x...`).
- [GET /api/defi/governance/vote-tx](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/governance/vote-tx): Build castVote. `?proposalId=&support=for|against|abstain`
- [GET /api/defi/governance/queue-tx](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/governance/queue-tx): Build queue() for Succeeded proposals.
- [GET /api/defi/governance/execute-tx](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/governance/execute-tx): Build execute() for Queued proposals past timelock.
- [GET /api/defi/emission](https://megachad.xyz/api/defi/emission): 225-week MEGAGOONER schedule + current week + split + on-chain weekly emission.

## Tier System

Burn count determines tier: Normie (0) → Mewer (1+) → Bonesmasher (3+) → Chad (10+) → Gigachad (25+). The wallet with the most burns overall is crowned MOGGER. All .mega domain holders appear on the Chadboard.

## ChadChat

Burn-gated real-time messaging on the Chadboard. Only wallets with at least 1 burn (Mewer tier+) can send messages. Powered by Ably.

## Telegram Alerts

Real-time burn and mint notifications via the MegaChad Telegram bot at https://t.me/megachads.

## MEGA Protocol DeFi Stack

The DeFi stack is fully agent-driven through the registry + DeFi endpoints + MCP tools above. Architecture:

- **$MEGAGOONER:** Governance/reward token (50M cap, 225-week quadratic emission). Formula: `weeklyEmission(w) = 662245 * ((225 - w) / 225)^2`.
- **EmissionController:** Splits each week's emission 45% MoggerStaking / 40% JESTERGOONER / 15% Treasury. Governance can rebalance within ±5% bounds with a 90-day cooldown.
- **MoggerStaking:** Stake MEGACHAD → earn MEGAGOONER (Synthetix-style continuous drip, no lock).
- **JESTERGOONER V4:** Stake MC/MG LP → earn MEGAGOONER (no lock; V4 removed the V3 4-week lock + time multiplier).
- **NFT boost (both venues):** Effective stake multiplier = 1.000× / 1.075× / 1.150× at 1+/10+/25+ NFTs. **1+ NFT is required to earn anything — wallets with zero NFTs accrue zero rewards.**
- **MegaChadLP MC/MG:** Constant-product AMM with 0.3% fee. Non-standard `tokenA`/`tokenB` layout — use `/api/defi/amm/*` instead of generic V2 routers.
- **Framemogger:** Weekly burn-to-govern. Send MEGACHAD + burn MEGAGOONER (1:4). Top 3 senders that week can propose in Jestermogger.
- **Jestermogger:** Snapshot-based MEGAGOONER governance. 1-day delay → 3-day vote → 2-day timelock → 7-day grace. 50% quorum.
- **NFTVetoCouncil:** Top 20 NFT-holding addresses. 11+ veto votes within 2 days cancel a queued proposal.
- **CircuitBreaker:** Any guardian can trip global pause in an emergency; admin clears.

## How to Interact (Agent Flow — DeFi)

1. `GET /.well-known/megachad-protocol.json` — cache the full registry.
2. `GET /api/defi/staking?address=0xYOU` — see your position + APRs.
3. `GET /api/defi/staking/tx?action=stake&venue=mogger&amount=10000&address=0xYOU` — sign + send the returned actions in order.
4. For MC↔MG swaps: `GET /api/defi/amm/quote?from=MC&amount=1000` → `GET /api/defi/amm/swap-tx?from=MC&amount=1000&recipient=0xYOU` → sign both actions.
5. For governance: `GET /api/defi/governance/proposals` → pick id → `GET /api/defi/governance/vote-tx?proposalId=N&support=for` → sign.

Or use natural language: POST `/api/agent/chat` with {"message": "stake 50000 megachad", "wallet": "0xYOU"} — returns the same calldata wrapped in an action plan.

## How to Interact (Agent Flow)

1. Get a swap quote: GET /api/x402/quote?ethAmount=0.5
2. Swap ETH for $MEGACHAD on Kumbaya DEX (on-chain tx using params from quote)
3. Get looksmaxx requirements: GET /api/x402/looksmaxx (returns 402 with burn + payment details)
4. Burn tokens: transfer 112,500 $MEGACHAD to 0x...dEaD, transfer 112,500 to tren fund wallet
5. Submit: POST /api/x402/looksmaxx with burn tx hashes, base64 image, and x402 payment payload
6. Receive: looksmaxxed image URL, IPFS CID, and minted NFT token ID

Or use natural language: POST /api/agent/chat with {"message": "looksmaxx 0xYOUR_WALLET"}
Or cross-chain: GET /api/cross-chain/intent?sourceChain=base&wallet=0xYOUR_WALLET
